Several days (Primal Ordeal missions + Magma Bubble, which can only be killed once every 20 h; the addon items are rare drops)

The {wiki:Fire-Fighter Outfits|Fire-Fighter Outfits} are earned in {wiki:Gnomprona|Gnomprona}, the gnomes' excavation next to a volcano beneath Marapur. The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest}, after you defeat the {creature:Magma Bubble}. The two addons are obtained by using two rare items dropped by the same boss: the {item:Firefighting Axe} and the {item:Portable Flame}. With the full outfit you earn the achievement **Friendly Fire**.
Gnomcruiter, Noodles Academy (Edron) — start of the Primal Ordeal
Level **250** (the quest's minimum level); for the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest} the **recommended level is 400**.

{wiki:Within the Tides Quest|Within the Tides Quest} completed (missions *Coastal Concerns*, *Mountainous Matters*, *Of Feathers and Flowers* and *Star-Crossed Lovers*): without it you cannot do the *Snakes on a Plain!* mission with the nagas of Marapur.
Base outfit: complete the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest} up to defeating {creature:Magma Bubble} and talking to {npc:Gnominer}.
Addons: a {item:Firefighting Axe} (1st addon) and a {item:Portable Flame} (2nd addon), both loot from {creature:Magma Bubble}.
Team of **up to 5 players** for {creature:Magma Bubble} (the fight is designed for a team: blocker, shooters and mages).
50 gp from Gnomfurry; melts after 2 hours (Fairy Trails! mission)

Base: by talking to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}) after defeating the {creature:Magma Bubble} in the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest}. Addons: by using the {item:Firefighting Axe} (1st) and the {item:Portable Flame} (2nd).
Requires Premium. The two addon items only drop from the Magma Bubble; no NPC sells or buys them, but they can be traded between players.
The base outfit is the end of the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest}: here is a summary of all the missions; that quest's guide has the same steps in more detail.

{creature:Magma Bubble} can only be killed **once every 20 hours**. Since the {item:Firefighting Axe} and the {item:Portable Flame} are rare, expect several attempts — or buy them from other players (they can be picked up and traded; no NPC sells or buys them).

On the {wiki:Steamship}, if you pay with coins larger than gold (for example only with a {item:Crystal Coin}), make sure you have room and capacity for the change: otherwise you still travel but the money stays on the boat.
The {wiki:Gnomprona|Gnomprona hub} is a safe zone; the three hunting areas around it ({wiki:Monster Graveyard}, {wiki:Crystal Enigma} and {wiki:Sparkling Pools}) have very strong creatures.
Gnomprona is an underground island beneath Marapur. You get there by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya}, the island south of Edron, after enlisting with the gnome recruiter in Edron.

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

Go to the seven towers of the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}, in the **eastern** part of Edron. {npc:Gnomcruiter} is **1 floor above** ground. Say {key:hi}, {key:talented}, {key:yes} and {key:join}: you are enlisted in the gnomes' expedition and he sends you to {npc:Gnominer}, the head of operations in Gnomprona.
Go back to Edron harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the **north** harbour of {wiki:Cormaya}.
Go down to the Cormaya Steamship

The Cormaya {wiki:Steamship} is **8 floors below** the island. The stairs are beneath the **Cormaya Garden**, the garden **south** of the pier, behind and just **east** of the guildhall *Castle of the White Dragon*. Go all the way down: {npc:Gurbasch} is at the end of Cormaya Street, opposite the house *Cormaya 11*.

If you are in **Kazordoon**, you can also take the Steamship from {npc:Brodrosch} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}; 160 gp): you arrive directly at Gurbasch's pier, without going through Edron. Only do this after enlisting with {npc:Gnomcruiter} (previous step).

Talk to {npc:Gurbasch}: {key:hi}, {key:gnomprona}, {key:yes}. The boat drops you at the Gnomprona hub pier, where captain {npc:Urks The Mute} is. The hub is a **safe zone**; {npc:Gnominer} is just **south** of the boat.
Map of Gnomprona: hub, hunting areas and mission locations
2. Base outfit — Primal Ordeal Quest missions

{npc:Gnominer} gives you the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest} missions one by one. To receive and hand in each mission, say {key:hi} and {key:challenger} to him. The task rooms are on the floor below the hub: enter the cave next to {npc:Gnomfurry} and head **south** to the **ore wagons**, which go to three places: the **left** one to the {wiki:Monster Graveyard} area, the **middle** one to the {wiki:Crystal Enigma} area and the **right** one to the {wiki:Sparkling Pools} area.

In the hub, just south of the boat, talk to {npc:Gnominer}: {key:hi} and {key:challenger}. He explains that he has lost seven scout fairies and asks you to find them and "remind them of their duty" with sweets.
Fairy Trails! — buy the Candy Lure

Go **south** to {npc:Gnomfurry}, next to the entrance to the wagon area. Say {key:hi} and {key:trade} and buy a {item:Candy Lure} (50 gp). The fairies only accept this sweet. It starts melting as soon as you buy it and lasts **2 hours**: hurry up or buy another one.

Use the {item:Candy Lure} on **7 different {wiki:Lazyfairy|Lazyfairies}**. Enter the cave next to Gnomfurry and head south to the wagons. **Three** fairies are in the **creature-free** stone passages where the wagons drop you; the **other four** are on the **floor above**, inside the hunting areas. Once you have all seven, go back to the hub the same way (wagon and Gnomfurry's cave) and talk to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}).

The creatures in the hunting areas are roughly as strong as those in the {wiki:Secret Library|Secret Library}, and the area's special mechanics can be very dangerous. Equipment: **Monster Graveyard** — protection against earth, death and fire; **Crystal Enigma** — earth and energy; **Sparkling Pools** — physical, energy and fire. In all of them, attack with **ice**.

{npc:Gnominer} sends you to collect flame charges at the **excavation site Moss**: go down to the wagons through {npc:Gnomfurry}'s cave and go to the entrance (use the coordinate and the Gnomprona map in section 1). Up to 5 players can enter, but progress is **individual**. You have to reach the other side of the room: kill the {creature:Blocking Stalagmite|Blocking Stalagmites} blocking the way and dodge the area attacks of the {wiki:Raging Monster|Raging Monsters} and {creature:Sulphur Menace|Sulphur Menaces} (they push you back and **use up the charges** you already have). Step on the flame to gain a charge and take it to the **energy extractor** at the start of the room. You need **3 charges**. Then leave the room, go back to the hub the same way and talk to Gnominer ({key:challenger}).
If you stand on the square where a Blocking Stalagmite spawns, it appears **south** of you and you can walk past it diagonally instead of killing it each time. It is much faster.
You have **10 minutes**. If you don't finish, you are kicked out of the room and can only try again after **20 hours**.

Use the **right wagon** and go to the **excavation site Firefoot**. You have to reach the structure at the back without stepping on **large fire fields**: the fields gradually change from ash to small fire and then to large fire. If a large fire catches you, you go back to the entrance and can try again. When you reach the end, a success message appears on screen. Then step on a large fire to go back to the entrance and leave through the teleport. Take the wagon back to the hub and talk to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}).

Use the **right wagon** again and go to **site GT-M-01**. Kill **3 {creature:Lesser Magma Crystal|Lesser Magma Crystals}**. Stepping on the fire fields takes **15% of your max health per second**: to avoid this, use the **energy extractor** near the entrance to gain a protective layer (shown as a number below your character's name). Then leave the room, take the wagon back to the hub and talk to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}).
Snakes on a Plain! — leave Gnomprona

The gnomes' artefact is old and broken, and the **nagas** of Marapur have one. Gnominer asks you to negotiate with them. To leave Gnomprona, go back to the pier where you arrived and talk to captain {npc:Urks The Mute} ({key:hi}) to take the boat back to Cormaya (the wiki doesn't record his dialogue; ask him about destinations). In Cormaya, climb the Cormaya Garden stairs to the surface and go to the **north** harbour: {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; 20 gp).
Snakes on a Plain! — go to the Kha'zeel Mountains

In Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} (160 gp). From **Ankrahmun**, leave the city to the **west** and climb on foot to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel Mountains}, between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun, by the same route you took in the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest|Within the Tides Quest}.
Bring the {spell:Levitate} spell: in the Kha'zeel Mountains many paths to the upper floors can only be taken by levitating.
Snakes on a Plain! — enter the portal to Marapur

Climb to the top of the mountain (floor +5) and enter the **portal**: you are teleported to {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}. This is the access to Marapur you earned in the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest|Within the Tides Quest}.
Snakes on a Plain! — talk to the Nagging Naga

In Marapur, find the {npc:Nagging Naga} and ask about the {key:artifact}. If you have already proven your loyalty to the nagas (in the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest|Within the Tides Quest}), they agree to send the artefact to the gnomes: answer {key:yes} to the question.
Leave Marapur and return to Gnomprona

To leave Marapur, go to the **Moonfall** magic carpet and talk to {npc:Ziyad}: say {key:hi} and ask him about destinations (carpets only serve Premium players); choose **Edron**, if available, or a city with a boat to Edron. Then repeat the route from section 1: {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({key:cormaya}) → Cormaya Garden stairs → {npc:Gurbasch} ({key:gnomprona}). Talk to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}) to hand in the mission and receive the next one.

Use the **left wagon** and enter the teleport. {creature:Lava Puddle (Creature)|Lava Puddles} start appearing: kill them and use their remains ({item:Charged Flame|Charged Flames}) on the green **polarity reversed crystals** to light **crystal flames**. Step on those flames to gain a charge and then step on the **large crystal plate** to the **south** to deliver it. **10 charges** are needed in total, regardless of how many players are in the room or who collects them. When you finish, a message appears in the centre of the room: leave the room, take the wagon back to the hub and talk to {npc:Gnominer} ({key:challenger}).

With the artefact in place and the tests done, the gnomes attack the volcano. This is the final fight of the Primal Ordeal Quest and also the boss you have to repeat to get the addon items. {creature:Magma Bubble} has **150,000** health, gives **80,000** experience, doesn't move, sees invisible, is **immune to earth** and can only be killed **once every 20 hours** (Bosstiary: Archfoe).

Gather **up to 5 players**. Equip protection against **fire** and **physical**. Attack with **ice** and **death**; **earth** damage is only useful for the {creature:The End of Days|End of Days} phase (Magma Bubble takes no earth damage). The typical team has a blocker (knight), shooters and mages.
Gain shield points and destroy the 3 Magma Crystals
The volcano entrance is in the {wiki:Sparkling Pools|Sparkling Pools} area, on the same floor as the hub; use the **right wagon** to go that way. Enter the volcano with your team.

The Sparkling Pools creatures ({creature:Emerald Tortoise}, {creature:Gore Horn}, {creature:Gorerilla}, {creature:Hulking Prehemoth}, {creature:Sabretooth (Creature)|Sabretooth}) are extremely strong: the wiki recommends level 600 to hunt there. They use physical damage (including at range), energy and fire, and one of them can root you.
Inside the arena is the **Gnomish Crystallomancer**. If he dies, the team **fails the fight**. Don't let the creatures attack him at any point during the fight.

The 3 {creature:Magma Crystal|Magma Crystals} are in an **overheated zone**: anyone who steps on the fire fields without protection takes **60% of their max health per second** in agony damage (it cannot be reduced), which is practically certain death. To gain protection: attack a {creature:The End of Days} until it is at half health; it heals fully and several {creature:Lava Creature|Lava Creatures} appear. When the Lava Creatures die, they leave {item:Charged Flame|Charged Flames} on the ground. Pick them up quickly and use them on the room's crystals when they turn **green** (they switch randomly between red and green, so run around the room looking for a green one before the flame disappears). Then step on the **purple flame** that appears: you gain **5 shield points**, shown below your character's name.
Unless the team can handle the damage from all the Lava Creatures, attack **one End of Days at a time** to control how many appear.

Gather several rounds of points: depending on the team's strength, at least **20 shield points across 4 players** (or more points with fewer players) before entering the overheated zone. Inside, attack the {creature:Magma Crystal} until you destroy it. Repeat until all three are destroyed. You can also gather all the points needed at once and then go to the three overheated zones, one after the other.
Keep **at least 5 shield points** so you can get out of the overheated zone! Any crystals left alive slowly heal while the team gathers more points.
Phase 2 — the six End of Days

{creature:The End of Days} appear again, this time **six** of them, but they no longer heal or spawn Lava Creatures. Take them to a spot where the blocker can hold them all **facing the wall**, or block them **south** of the crystal in the middle of the room, so none of them faces the shooters and the mages can use waves safely. Earth damage is useful here.

When the six End of Days die, {creature:Magma Bubble} appears. It always summons **four {creature:Unchained Fire|Unchained Fires}**, so use single-target attacks on the boss. This phase is usually faster and simpler than the previous one. The knight must stop the Unchained Fires from **facing the boss**: their fire waves **heal Magma Bubble a lot**.
The Unchained Fires deal a lot of area fire damage. Shooters should bring plenty of fire protection and stand **diagonally** to get hit less. Magma Bubble also casts fireballs (about 407–556 damage).
Magma Bubble loot (may include the Firefighting Axe and/or the Portable Flame)

The wiki doesn't describe the exit from the boss arena. After the fight, leave the volcano the same way you came in and go back through the Sparkling Pools area and the **right wagon** to the Gnomprona hub (safe zone), where {npc:Gnominer} is.

Talk to {npc:Gnominer}: {key:hi} and {key:challenger}. You receive the base {wiki:Fire-Fighter Outfits|Fire-Fighter Outfit}. Also talk to {npc:Gnomadness} if you want access to the **Hazard System** and the boss {creature:The Primal Menace} (optional part of the Primal Ordeal Quest).
Official artwork of the Fire-Fighter Outfits
4. Addons — Firefighting Axe and Portable Flame
You don't ask any NPC for the two addons: you just **use** the right item. Both items only drop from {creature:Magma Bubble}.

Repeat the fight from section 3 (once every 20 hours) until the {item:Firefighting Axe} and the {item:Portable Flame} drop. They are rare drops: neither appeared in the 77 kills recorded in the wiki's loot statistics. You can also buy them from other players (no NPC sells them).

Items from the Alicorn, Arboreal, Arcanomancer, Spiritthorn and Ethereal sets ({item:Alicorn Headguard}, {item:Alicorn Quiver}, {item:Charged Alicorn Ring}, {item:Arboreal Crown}, {item:Charged Arboreal Ring}, {item:Arboreal Tome}, {item:Arcanomancer Folio}, {item:Arcanomancer Regalia}, {item:Charged Arcanomancer Sigil}, {item:Spiritthorn Armor}, {item:Spiritthorn Helmet}, {item:Charged Spiritthorn Ring}, {item:Charged Ethereal Ring})
Use the {item:Firefighting Axe}. The message *"You feel like fighting a fire!"* appears and you receive the first Fire-Fighter addon.

Use the {item:Portable Flame}. The message *"The flame engulfs you!"* appears and you receive the second addon. After using **both** items you earn the achievement **Friendly Fire** (*"You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!"*).

To return to the mainland, go to the hub pier and talk to captain {npc:Urks The Mute} ({key:hi}) to take the boat back to Cormaya (the wiki doesn't record his dialogue; ask him about destinations). In Cormaya, climb the Cormaya Garden stairs to the surface and go to the **north** harbour: {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; 20 gp). Alternatively, at the lower pier, {npc:Gurbasch} runs Steamship trips to **Kazordoon** ({key:kazordoon}, 160 gp).
This outfit was added in version 12.90 (Summer Update 2022), together with the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest|Primal Ordeal Quest} and Gnomprona.

After defeating Magma Bubble, {npc:Gnomadness} gives you access to the Gnomprona Hazard System and the boss {creature:The Primal Menace} (20-hour cooldown), from which you can earn the {wiki:Ripptor|Ripptor} mount and an item from the {wiki:Primal Set|Primal Set}. This is part of the Primal Ordeal Quest and is not needed for the outfit.
The {item:Firefighting Axe} weighs 16 oz and the {item:Portable Flame} 0.15 oz; neither is sold or bought by NPCs.
